purpose: Item 4 of 'automate everything': 3D (extruded 2D sections) in the autonomous loop. Predictions fixed before any 3D solve.

problems.plate_hole_quarter_3d_pe: problems3d/plate_hole_quarter_3d_pe.json: the quarter plate with a hole (10 x 10, r = 1, E and nu of the 2D problem), thickness 1, rollers on both z faces (plane strain); 2D counterpart problems2d/plate_hole_quarter_pe.json (plane strain)
problems.cook_3d: problems3d/cook_3d.json: Cook's membrane section, thickness 1, z faces free, clamped x = 0, shear traction 0.0625 per unit area on x = 48 (total 1 per unit thickness, as in 2D)

predictions.P1_mms: 3D manufactured-solution check PASS for both elements (27-node hexahedra and 10-node tetrahedra; L2 rate within 0.2 of 3, H1 within 0.2 of 2), on both problems (levels may be added by the toward-theory rule)
predictions.P2_planestrain_identity: plate 3D plane strain, Q2 hexahedra: at every level n = 2..16 the 3D solution equals the 2D plane-strain Q2 solution of the same level (same in-plane mesh; z-independent field exactly representable): strain_energy / thickness, u_right, v_hole_top and peak_von_mises agree to 1e-8 relative
predictions.P3_planestrain_limits: plate 3D plane strain: every quantity certified in 3D has a certified limit within the combined uncertainty (U3D + U2D, absolute) of the 2D plane-strain certified limit (strain energy per unit thickness)
predictions.P4_plate_loop: the loop on plate_hole_quarter_3d_pe finds no singular edges (corners and face edges empty) and certifies at least 3 of its 4 quantities
predictions.P5_cook_edges: cook_3d: the three 2D corners of the 2D Cook run are singular z edges, and the clamped side meeting the free z faces gives singular face edges with an in-plane exponent below 1
predictions.P6_cook_values: cook_3d: the certified (or, if not certified, finest Q2) v_C is within 2% of the 2D plane-stress reference 23.96, and strain_energy / thickness within 2% of the 2D plane-stress certified 12.02
predictions.P7_cook_peak: cook_3d: peak_von_mises is concluded not verifiable (an exponent below 1)
predictions.P8_memory_guard: on cook_3d a Q2 level n = 32 exceeds the 450,000-DOF guard (if the agent proposes it, the solve is refused before it starts and recorded as a failed experiment, not a crash)

amendments_before_scoring: A1 (code fix, found by a volume check before any loop result): the first 3D mesher meshed section and volume in one step; coarse quadrilateral sections kept triangles whose prisms were dropped on loading (up to 21% of the volume missing; the manufactured-solution check did not notice because it imposes exact tractions on every boundary, including the holes left). Now the section is meshed first as in 2D and then extruded; a volume guard refuses any mesh that does not fill the domain. Prediction P2 (same in-plane mesh as 2D) relies on this.
A2 (same remedy as rounds K/L): scikit-fem's inverse isoparametric map tolerance scaled to the round-off floor (27-node hexahedra with coordinates ~ 50 failed at n = 16).

A3 (test design, after the first Cook manufactured-solution levels, before scoring): the through-thickness wavenumber of the manufactured field changed from 0.7 pi / T to 1.3 pi / max(T, smallest section side). With the first field the thin Cook plate (elements 24 times wider than thick) converged too slowly for the memory-limited levels: with the original field, tetrahedra L2 errors 1.166e3, 23.06, 1.534, 0.3555 at n = 2, 4, 8, 16 (orders 5.7, 3.9, 2.1 with the nominal h; not settled: below the theoretical 3 at n = 16 and still changing), hexahedra failed at n = 16 (A2). No prediction text changed.
